## Purpose

`template_template` is the meta-research exemplar: it studies a template-like
checkout by introspecting repository structure, public project scope, pipeline
metadata, metrics, figures, and manuscript tokens.

## Copy This When

Use it when the fork's subject is the template repository itself or another
checkout that deliberately preserves the same architecture and infrastructure
interfaces.

## Fork and verify

Fork this standalone repository and use its [rendering workflow](rendering_pipeline.md)
with your checkout under a distinct working project name. Review
[the project configuration](manuscript/config.yaml), `domain_profile.yaml`,
`experiment_plan.yaml`, and the citation metadata for the fork.

The manuscript describes the Template repository it inspects. Run the real
metrics and figure producers against the intended reference before interpreting
new results. The [verification guide](VERIFICATION.md) describes the SDK and
complete source reference required for standalone acceptance.
